subject: EU data control + localisation — SCCs, hosting options, and operational safeguards
messages:
From: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@novapay.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com
Cc: contracts@novapay.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 14:14:00 +0200
Subject: EU-only processing & SCCs — quick clarifications

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. As we move toward legal review, two quick clarifications from NovaPay legal: 1) We need confirmation that customer data from EU users will be processed solely within EU regions (no tokenization or backups routed to US), and 2) we'd like to understand Redwood's stance post-Schrems II — do you execute the EU SCCs (standard contractual clauses) and offer any additional safeguards (encryption, BYOK, dedicated tenancy)?

Can you share the shortest possible answer we can pass to our counsel? Also, if you have an example executed SCCs addendum or a network/hosting map for EU deployments, that would help.

Appreciate it — Anna

--
Anna Schmidt
Senior Counsel, NovaPay
anna.schmidt@novapay.com
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com
To: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@novapay.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodai.com, marissa_cole@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: EU-only processing & SCCs — quick clarifications

Hi Anna — great to meet you. Short answers up front, details below: 1) EU-only processing: Yes — we can restrict processing to EU-hosted regions for production traffic (Redwood hosted) and provide a Dedicated/Private deployment option for stronger isolation. 2) SCCs: We do execute the EU Standard Contractual Clauses for customers electing EU-only processing; we can provide an executed sample and a redlined SCCs addendum for NovaPay legal to review.

Details / options: 
- Hosted (recommended for speed): We offer redwood-hosted inference in EU cloud regions — data at rest and in-flight remain in-region; backups and logs for the EU-only tenancy are retained in-region.
- Dedicated: Customers can reserve dedicated GPU pools in EU regions with network isolation and stronger retention controls.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): Customer-managed network, optional air-gap.

Additional safeguards we offer:
- BYOK (customer-managed keys) for encryption of persisted artifacts (available for Dedicated/Private).
- Regional KMS integrations and HSM options for enterprise plans.
- Audit logs and per-request tracing for compliance evidence.

I've looped in Kimberly from Legal and Marissa from Product Ops to attach the SCCs redline and the hosting/network map you requested.

Next step: Kimberly — can you attach the current SCCs addendum sample and call out anything NovaPay counsel should expect to redline?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com

Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: EU-only processing & SCCs — quick clarifications

Anna / Vanessa — attaching: 1) redline_sccs_addendum_v1.pdf (sample addendum we execute; typical redlines we see in the field are around data subprocessing transparency, logging retention windows, and audit frequency), and 2) executed_sccs_sample.pdf (an anonymized executed SCCs pack for reference).

Quick notes from Legal: 
- We execute the EU SCCs; we include subprocessor disclosures and a standard security commitments section.
- For customers requiring extra safeguards under Schrems II, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments + BYOK. While SCCs remain the contractual base, technical measures (encryption at rest with customer keys, restricting egress, and contractually committed access controls) are the practical mitigations.
- If NovaPay requires Data Localization certification/attestation, we'll need a scoping call to confirm the specific endpoints and logs that must remain in-EU.

Neha — can you confirm the retention defaults for EU hosted tenants and whether logs/backups are region-bound by default?

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwoodai.com
To: kimberly_park@redwoodai.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com, Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@novapay.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 15:22:00 +0100
Subject: RE: EU-only processing & SCCs — quick clarifications

Hi all — operational confirmation: 
- Retention: Default token/log retention for EU-hosted production tenants is 90 days; customer logs and KV caches can be configured shorter on request.
- Backups & DR snapshots: For EU-only tenancies, snapshots are stored in-region and encrypted. We do not replicate snapshots to non-EU regions for EU-only flagged tenants.
- Back-office access: Access to EU tenant data by Redwood Ops is multi-factor protected and requires privileged approval; we maintain audit trails of all such access.

Attachments we can provide: hosting_network_map.pdf (high-level network/region map for EU hosting) and a SOC 2 summary link on the drive.

If NovaPay needs a written attestation of in-region backups and no cross-border processing, we can produce an evidence package but will need a 7–10 business day turnaround to gather logs and produce signed confirmation.

-Neha Kapoor
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference

1) For BYOK, can you confirm whether Redwood has any ability to reconstruct keys or whether keys are stored only in the customer's KMS?
2) For audit evidence, would a one-time attestation plus a sample access log be sufficient to satisfy internal auditors, or do you offer ongoing attestation/quarterly reports?

If you can attach the redline and hosting map, that would help the team move to contracting.

Thanks — Anna
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com

Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2026 16:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: EU-only processing & SCCs — quick clarifications

Anna — quick answers and next steps below.

1) BYOK: For Dedicated/Private customers who opt for BYOK, keys are provisioned in the customer's external KMS and Redwood does not store plaintext keys. We integrate with customer KMS (Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault, customer HSM); Redwood retains only key references and performs crypto operations via APIs to the customer KMS. In short: Redwood cannot reconstruct customer keys.

2) Audit evidence: We provide a one-time signed attestation and a sample anonymized access log on request. For enterprise contracts we can package quarterly attestation reports and longer retention for audit logs as an add-on.

Attachments included: redline_sccs_addendum_v1.pdf, hosting_network_map.pdf, executed_sccs_sample.pdf (for your counsel).

Proposed next steps:
- NovaPay counsel reviews attached SCCs addendum and flags redlines (deadline suggestion: 10 business days).
- If NovaPay wants BYOK + Dedicated, we'll scope infra and provide an SOW + pricing.
- We can schedule a short technical call (30 min) with Neha and our infra lead to walk the hosting map and timelines.

Would Thursday 06 Aug for a 30-min call work for your team?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
